recipe.visualDefinition: A long-exposure night photograph of a glowing Ferris wheel serves as the backdrop for a dense, multi-font typographic layout featuring marquee-style headers and a variety of colorful sans-serif and slab-serif sub-headers.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular motion of the Ferris wheel lights frames the central text block.
The warm yellow glow of the carnival lights contrasts against the deep blue night sky.
The large marquee-style title at the top establishes a hierarchy over the scattered song titles.
The varied colors of the text (white, cyan, yellow, orange) create a vibrant, chaotic energy reflecting a fairground.
coreInvariants: Long-exposure light trails on the Ferris wheel
Marquee-bulb texture inside the primary title
Eclectic mix of at least four distinct font styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large Ferris wheel occupies the center and right two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary title at the top edge with its bright red and yellow marquee effect.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top marquee title, follow the curve of the Ferris wheel down, and then scan the left-aligned list of secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark night sky in the upper left and center provides a canvas for the text overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue and black (background/night sky)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white (light trails and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red (marquee border) and cyan/orange (secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, high saturation lights against a low value, low saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between text and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy condensed sans-serif and wide slab-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick block letters filled with a grid of circular light bulbs.
Secondary titles use a mix of ultra-condensed and ultra-extended widths.
Script elements are used sparingly for subtitles.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title characters feature a red stroke with an internal yellow bulb pattern.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Intentional discordance; mixing widths and styles to mimic 1960s advertising variety.

preserve: Mix of condensed and extended fonts

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A long-exposure night photograph of a Ferris wheel at a carnival. The wheel is lit with warm yellow lights creating circular streaks. The background is a dark navy blue sky. The bottom of the frame shows blurred carnival lights and structures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large marquee-style title at the top with red outlines and yellow bulb fills. Below it, arrange a list of song titles on the left side using a variety of bold condensed and extended fonts in white, cyan, and yellow. Add a small script subtitle in yellow near the top right.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have a visible light-bulb texture?
Is the Ferris wheel blurred to show motion?
Are there at least three different colors used for the text?
Is the text layout primarily left-aligned but scattered?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the marquee bulbs don't look like simple dots but glowing sources.
Check that the text colors pop against the dark blue sky.
Verify the Ferris wheel looks like a long-exposure photo, not a static illustration.
Confirm the typographic variety feels intentional and retro.
recipe.reuseFormula: Night Carnival Background + Marquee Header + Eclectic Multi-Font List = Mid-Century Entertainment Aesthetic
